story_targets.narrative_hook: Balotelli's iconic double sends Germany home: the rise of Italian brilliance against the tournament favorites

events.description: Balotelli rises highest to head in a Cassano cross. Italy 1-0 Germany. The Italian superstar breaks the deadlock with a powerful header
Balotelli scores a stunning second goal. Montolivo plays a perfect through ball, Balotelli runs onto it and unleashes an unstoppable strike past Neuer. Italy 2-0 Germany
Balotelli removes his shirt and strikes his iconic bodybuilder pose. The image of raw power and emotion. Later he is seen being calmed by teammates and sharing a moment with his mother in the stands
Ozil scores a late consolation penalty for Germany after a handball in the box. Germany 1-2 Italy. But it's too little too late
Full time whistle. Italy beat Germany 2-1 to reach the Euro 2012 final. The German giant is slain. Italian players celebrate reaching the final
